topic: France used the guillotine until 1977 - the year Star Wars came out
taste: No people shown or named; the guillotine is a faceless cartoon object; no blood. Characters are 1977 objects (cassette, TV).

claims.claim: The last execution by guillotine in France took place on 10 September 1977 at Baumettes Prison, Marseille.
Star Wars was released in 1977 (US 25 May 1977; first UK screenings 27 December 1977).
The guillotine was first used in France in April 1792, during the French Revolution.
The last public guillotining in France was in 1939; after that, executions were carried out inside prisons.
France abolished the death penalty in 1981.
